theorem_title: Exact rational logarithm enclosures for the sharp-tail entropy arguments
natural_language_statement: Encloses the natural logarithms of 44399/1050000, 1005601/1050000, 5601/50000 and 44399/50000 between the exact rational endpoints in the statement. The first pair describes u=(1-0.11202)/21 and 1-u; the second describes theta=0.11202 and 1-theta. The bounds certify the sharp saving and query exponent. The proof reuses the log(2) bounds from the encoding logarithm certificate to scale all arguments into [1,2].
